collectionNote: Sixteen of seventeen dimensions were never collected. The previous phase's comparison asked three questions and answered them well; this model asks seventeen, so the same evidence now reports INCONCLUSIVE rather than three-of-four established. That is not a regression: it is the difference between a comparison and a formality. Collecting the remaining sixteen needs a build on each of two independent builders, which is what .github/workflows/independent-builder.yml exists to provide.

rawArchive.detail: Both archives 1,852,006,400 bytes. Measured on the Fedora 44 WSL2 builder across two isolated workspaces at commit 79bb99dd.

priorMeasurements.note: Recorded by scripts/reproducibility/compare-builds.py during the previous phase. Real measurements, retained as informational: the per-builder values behind them were not committed in full, so they cannot serve as dimension comparisons here.
priorMeasurements.sbomFileDigestNote: The two SBOM file digests differ because syft stamps a fresh UUID namespace, a creation timestamp and a root entry named after the input path. 6076 of 6077 package entries matched exactly; the one that did not was document identity and its content digest was identical in both.
